implemented_requirements.requirement: Initialize an 8x8 board with the standard starting position
Identify all valid moves for the current player
implemented_requirements.evidence: board.py: def valid_moves(self, player) returns list of (r,c) where flips_for is non‑empty

implemented_requirements.requirement: Flip opponent discs that are bounded by the new disc and another disc of the same colour
implemented_requirements.evidence: board.py: flips_for() scans in all 8 DIRECTIONS and collect opponent discs; apply_move() flips them

implemented_requirements.requirement: Alternate turns between two players and handle pass when a player has no moves
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py: self.current toggles in next_turn(); play() checks board.has_move(self.current) and passes turn

implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py: over() returns board.is_full() or not (board.has_move('B') or board.has_move('W'))

implemented_requirements.requirement: Display the board, current scores and list of valid moves each turn
